title: Login loop and payment/driver failures block core Uber ride flow
description: Users are unexpectedly logged out at critical moments and get stuck in an infinite login loop. Payment methods are rejected, drivers cancel without penalty, and overcharges go unresolved due to a broken help system.
affected_component: Authentication / Payment / Driver Dispatch

title: Lock-screen ads override alarm clock and block phone unlock
description: App injects unsolicited full-screen ads and screensavers onto the device lock screen, disrupting alarm functionality and forcing users to dismiss ads before they can unlock their phone. AppLock feature also fails to lock targeted apps.
affected_component: Lock Screen / Ad Delivery / AppLock

title: Gallery thumbnails show as blank and edits fail to save after update
description: After a recent update, photo thumbnails appear as blank squares when browsing the gallery, saved edits do not persist, and the app requires an active internet connection to function. Reinstalling does not resolve the issue.
affected_component: Gallery / Photo Import / Save & Export

title: Login fails on new device; registration loops when email/phone already in use
description: Users cannot sign in to existing accounts when switching to a new device. The registration flow loops back on itself when the email or phone number is already registered. Per-device account state resets, forcing full re-setup of content preferences.
affected_component: Authentication / Account Management / Session Persistence

title: News reader crashes repeatedly; keyboard hides comment box on tablet; cannot uninstall
description: On Samsung Tab S2 the on-screen keyboard covers the comment entry area. The article reader crashes on every use. The app is pre-installed bloatware that cannot be uninstalled. Loading screen now blocks the headline page on entry.
affected_component: Article Reader / Comment UI / Install/Uninstall / Navigation

title: Video import fails with "file destroyed" error; export completes silently with no output
description: Users cannot import their own video files into the editor, receiving a "file you choose may have been destroyed" error. The trim tool does not honor the selected start time. Export appears to complete but produces no output file and no error notification.
affected_component: Video Import / Trim / Export

title: Add fare estimate, driver rating/reporting, and accurate ETA on map
description: Riders want the fare estimate feature restored before booking, ability to rate or report drivers who cancel or no-show, accurate vehicle position on map, and better trip planning tools. Credit card management and name editing are also broken in the current UI.
affected_component: Fare Estimation / Driver Rating / Map / Account Settings

title: Reduce ad frequency; remove full-screen and lock-screen ads by default
description: Users describe ads as excessive and request that full-screen interstitial ads be removed entirely. App silently enables lock-screen ads and ad-related features by default. Users want fewer, less intrusive ads or a clean opt-in default state.
affected_component: Ad Delivery / Lock Screen / Default Settings

title: Add fast-forward/rewind, subtitles, next/prev track, and original audio removal in video editor
description: Users request fast-forward and fast-backward controls in the video player, ability to import and display subtitle files, next/previous track navigation buttons, option to remove the original audio track from a video, and longer maximum output duration beyond the current 30-second cap.
affected_component: Video Player / Audio Editor / Subtitle Support / Export

title: Allow users to filter and block news sources; reduce clickbait in the feed
description: Users want persistent source filtering so blocked sources stay removed from their feed. Clickbait articles and content from unaccredited sources surface frequently with no way to filter them out. The new update made the interface heavier and less readable than the previous version.
affected_component: News Feed / Source Management / Content Filtering / UI

title: General UX improvements: simplify flows, add configuration options, improve speed
description: A loose cluster of generic improvement requests from users who find the app has become more complicated over time. Users ask for simpler flows, more configuration options, and faster overall performance. No single specific feature dominates the cluster.
affected_component: General UX / Settings / Performance

title: Preserve full-resolution photo export; offer HD output at original megapixels
description: After editing, exported photos are significantly reduced in size and quality compared to the original. Users with DSLR-quality input photos lose megapixels on export and want lossless or near-lossless HD output options, comparable to desktop tools like Photoshop.
affected_component: Photo Export / Image Quality / Output Resolution

title: Saved photo quality is severely degraded; output capped at 480p in free tier
description: Photos saved after editing are visibly blurred and low quality compared to the in-app preview. Camera capture changes colors between preview and final shot. Free tier output is capped at 480p, producing artifacts far below modern mobile display standards.
affected_component: Photo/Video Export / Camera Capture / Output Encoding

title: In-app video ads drain battery and make app unusable on mobile data
description: Video ads served within the app significantly drain battery and consume mobile data bandwidth, making the app unusable on cellular connections. A fake "disable ads" toggle silently re-enables itself. Lock screen ad injection also interferes with the device alarm.
affected_component: Ad Delivery / Battery Management / Lock Screen / Settings

title: App drains battery rapidly when running or in background
description: Users report the app consumes battery at an abnormally high rate both during active use and when running in the background via persistent notifications. Battery life is reported to drop to one-third of normal with the app installed and active.
affected_component: Background Services / Battery / Notifications

title: App causes system-wide device slowdown, freezes screen, and blocks unlock
description: Running the app causes the entire device to slow down significantly, not just the app itself. Games and other apps shut down. The device becomes nearly impossible to unlock while charging. Screen freeze is reported across multiple device types.
affected_component: Background Processes / Memory Management / System Performance

title: News feed surfaces clickbait; ignores topic preferences; app reinstalls itself
description: The news feed serves clickbait and gossip content instead of real news. Users cannot select more than a limited number of topics. Notifications fire even after being disabled. The app reportedly reinstalls itself after removal. These behaviors remove meaningful user control over content and notifications.
affected_component: News Feed / Topic Selection / Notifications / Install/Uninstall

title: Aggressive interstitial ads and forced sign-in interrupt core user workflows
description: Users are shown relentless interstitial ads from the moment of install, forced to create an account to proceed, and report seeing ads even after paying for an ad-free subscription. The experience makes the app feel unusable and erodes trust in the subscription model.
affected_component: Ad Delivery / Onboarding / Subscription / Account System

title: Displayed fare and ETA do not match actual ride experience, eroding rider trust
description: Uber calculates fares using the longest available route rather than the optimal one. Quoted fares change every few minutes and are not guaranteed. Drivers cancel trips and riders are still charged. Map shows vehicles as nearby when they are actually far away.
affected_component: Fare Calculation / ETA / Map / Driver Dispatch

title: App hangs on blank white screen and fails to load on Samsung Galaxy S6/S7 and Xiaomi Redmi 3S
description: On Samsung Galaxy S4, S6, S7, S7 Edge and Xiaomi Redmi 3S the app opens to a blank white screen and never loads. The issue occurs after install or after a software update. The app cannot be removed from some affected devices. Download also stalls at a fixed percentage.
affected_component: App Launch / Install / Update / Uninstall
